Politics · India

Leaders address Yamuna cleaning, climate action, and cultural ties

Multiple Indian Chief Ministers and the Prime Minister have been active on various fronts. The Delhi CM participated in a Yamuna cleaning drive, emphasizing public support for its rejuvenation. Meanwhile, the Prime Minister highlighted shared cultural symbols and called for equitable climate action during a visit to Seychelles, stressing the impact of climate change on island nations and the Global South. Other leaders discussed cultural bonds and agricultural support.
